note: Office types every locality of a state has (lexflow:office-type:<st>:<slug>; publish/graph.py). A state model's role whose actor id or name matches an entry's 'match' words is 'played by' the office type when no body plays it, and a researched local office whose name matches is an 'instance of' it, so a locality query resolves a state step to the local office. The Virginia entries are the constitutional officers of Va. Const. art. VII, § 4 plus the general registrar (Va. Code § 24.2-110). 'match' is matched case-insensitively against the whole name as a regular expression; 'actors' lists state-model actor ids.

commissioner_of_the_revenue.name: Commissioner of the Revenue
commissioner_of_the_revenue.description: Constitutional officer of a Virginia county or city who assesses local taxes and issues business licences (Va. Const. art. VII, § 4; Va. Code § 58.1-3100 ff.)

treasurer.name: Treasurer
treasurer.description: Constitutional officer of a Virginia county or city who bills and collects local taxes and fees (Va. Const. art. VII, § 4; Va. Code § 58.1-3123 ff.)

clerk_of_the_circuit_court.name: Clerk of the Circuit Court
clerk_of_the_circuit_court.description: Constitutional officer who keeps the records of a Virginia circuit court, records deeds and issues marriage licences and probate (Va. Const. art. VII, § 4; Va. Code § 17.1-200 ff.)

attorney_for_the_commonwealth.name: Attorney for the Commonwealth
attorney_for_the_commonwealth.description: Constitutional officer who prosecutes for the Commonwealth in a Virginia county or city (Va. Const. art. VII, § 4; Va. Code § 15.2-1626 ff.)

sheriff.name: Sheriff
sheriff.description: Constitutional officer of a Virginia county or city (Va. Const. art. VII, § 4; Va. Code § 15.2-1609 ff.)

general_registrar.name: General Registrar
general_registrar.description: The officer who registers voters and runs elections in a Virginia county or city, with the electoral board (Va. Code § 24.2-110 ff.)
